Stubs: one synthetic tumor story (FROZEN v1.0.0)

Synthetic, no patient data. Every file here is generated by python -m shared.stubs.make_stubs (byte-identical on every run) and validates with python -m shared.validate --stubs. Every number a paper would provide is a placeholder (stub: true, sources say STUB placeholder). Use these as inputs until the real upstream letter exists; INT swaps them for real files.

The story, in pipeline order:

  1. anatomy_masks/: geometric chest phantom, 160 × 128 × 80 voxels at (2.0, 2.0, 2.5) mm, LPS, centred on the origin: elliptic body (40 HU), two ellipsoid lungs (−850 HU) with five lobes, four vessel tubes (40 HU), trachea (−1000 HU). Noise-free.
  2. site_candidates/sites.json: S001 free (right lung, RLL), S002 juxtavascular, S003 juxtapleural (left lung); context vectors computed from the masks with distance transforms.
  3. rulebook/: 2 nodes: solid (CPT selected by placement_class) → spiculated.
  4. compiled_circuit/: the rulebook for context free as Ry/CRy, transpiled to FakeMarrakesh.
  5. quantum_job_record/: a real ideal-Aer run of that circuit (1000 shots, seed 7).
  6. certificate/: pass, placeholder S = 2.70 with H_min from the Pironio bound, placeholder extracted seed.
  7. tumor_draw/: D0001 at S001, 8 mm, type/margin decoded from the most frequent outcome.
  8. witness_record/, memory_advantage_record/, simulability_report/, quantum_lineage/, seed_shape/: placeholder D records; seed shape = 7³ ball.
  9. growth_trajectory/: baseline (step 0, r = 1.5 mm, proliferating) and follow-up (step 30, r = 4 mm with necrotic core and dormant shell), 33³ lattice at 0.5 mm centred on S001.
  10. lesion_model_library/, scanner_fingerprint/ (σ map = 12 HU in body): placeholder F parameters.
  11. hybrid_volume/: host CT + 8 mm sphere at 30 HU at S001 + ground-truth mask.
  12. receipt/ (Ed25519 with a fixed stub key, sha256(b"qp-re-stub-key")), ledger_entry/ledger.jsonl (genesis + receipt, chained), validation_report/ (empty report shape).
  13. run_record/: the run record of the generator's own Aer job (git state omitted so it stays byte-identical).

Regenerate after any change to shared/*.py: the stubs embed code_hash(shared/).

Source: shared/stubs/README.md

Simulation only (AerSimulator ideal / FakeMarrakesh Heron-class noise); no hardware results. Generated from Markdown + status.json by python -m shared.site.build.
